scenes.title: Same modules. New possibilities.
scenes.description: Four familiar blocks, different ways to work together.

scenes.title: Share the workflow
scenes.description: Separate responsibilities. Each module handles its part.

scenes.title: Change independently
scenes.description: Two independent dimensions, combined as needed.

scenes.title: Connect the responses

description: Explore the problem, change the structure, and see why it works. Interactive examples connect each pattern to real code.
status: All 23 lessons are ready. Choose a real scenario and explore changes in structure and code.

creational.name: Creational
creational.description: Separate how objects are created from how they are used.

singleton.name: Singleton
singleton.summary: Provide one shared instance and a single access point.

abstract-factory.name: Abstract Factory
abstract-factory.summary: Create compatible objects as a consistent family.

builder.name: Builder
builder.summary: Build complex objects one step at a time.

prototype.name: Prototype
prototype.summary: Create new objects by copying existing ones.

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.summary: Let abstraction and implementation evolve independently.

composite.name: Composite
composite.summary: Treat individual objects and object trees uniformly.

decorator.name: Decorator
decorator.summary: Add responsibilities by wrapping an object.

facade.name: Facade
facade.summary: Offer a simple entry point to a complex subsystem.

flyweight.name: Flyweight
flyweight.summary: Share repeated state across many similar objects.

proxy.name: Proxy
proxy.summary: Control access through a stand-in object.

chain-of-responsibility.name: Chain of Responsibility
chain-of-responsibility.summary: Pass a request along a chain of handlers.

command.name: Command
command.summary: Turn an action into an object for queues and undo.

interpreter.name: Interpreter
interpreter.summary: Interpret a simple language using expression objects.

iterator.name: Iterator
iterator.summary: Traverse a collection without exposing its structure.

memento.name: Memento
memento.summary: Save and restore state without exposing internals.

observer.name: Observer
observer.summary: Notify subscribers when an object changes.

state.name: State
state.summary: Change behavior by switching state objects.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.summary: Swap algorithms without changing the main workflow.

template-method.name: Template Method
template-method.summary: Keep an algorithm skeleton and customize its steps.

visitor.name: Visitor
visitor.summary: Add operations without changing an object structure.
